_doc: Updates / « Nouvelles » (updates.py; README 'Updates'). One object per post in 'entries', any order (the site sorts newest first). Each mirrors one of Joachim's social posts; he sends it, we add it. Fields: date (YYYY-MM-DD, required); title_en (title or first line, max 90, required); title_fr (optional, falls back to title_en); body_en / body_fr (optional, max 280 each; FR falls back to EN); slug (optional, lowercase ASCII and hyphens, max 60, no date; default from title_en; permalink /updates/<date>-<slug>/, must be unique); place / place_fr (optional, max 60); links (optional list of {platform: instagram|facebook|x, url: https://... on instagram.com / facebook.com, fb.com / x.com, twitter.com}); images (optional list of 0-4 photos: a file name in site/data/updates/, or {file, focus [x, y], alt_en, alt_fr}; 'image' with one file name also works); alt_en / alt_fr (optional photo description for all photos; default: the title). Only photos Joachim provides: never his daughter, his home or a private address. Then run tools/make_updates.py and commit data/updates.json, data/updates/ and assets/img/updates/. While 'entries' is empty, nothing of the feature appears on the site.

_example.body_en: Thanks to everyone who came by Discovery Coffee this morning. Good questions on housing and the ferries.
_example.body_fr: Merci à toutes les personnes passées au Discovery Coffee ce matin. De bonnes questions sur le logement et les traversiers.
